The science-v4 runtime includes an unmodified MSVCP140.dll (AMD64,
file/product version 14.40.33810.0, 575056 bytes). Its SHA256 is:
a4c2229bdc2a2a630acdc095b4d86008e5c3e3bc7773174354f3da4f5beb9cde

The original bytes are retained from the SHA256-pinned official NumPy 2.4.6
wheel member numpy.libs/msvcp140-a4c2229bdc2a2a630acdc095b4d86008.dll.
The additional science-v4/MSVCP140.dll file is a byte-identical app-local
alias for OpenMM's imports. The original NumPy member is also retained.
